QuestInfo.name: Hughes the Fuse's Basic Theory of Science
QuestInfo.0: When I visited Moren to learn his new method, he instructed me to attend a class on the Basic Theory of Science taught by that eccentric scientist Hughes the Fuse. This worries me quite a bit...
QuestInfo.1: Moren said in order to attend the class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy, I must visit #bHughes the Fuse#k, who is holed up somewhere inside Orbis Tower, doing his own thing.
QuestInfo.2: I was able to keep track of Hughes the Fuse's disorienting science class. Yay!!

0.0: The class on the theory of science will be run by my dear friend #bHughes the Fuse#k! You can find Hughes the Fuse hunkered down in his lab somewhere inside Orbis Tower of El Nath! \nAh! The tuition for the class will be #b10,000 mesos#k, paid in advance! Will you sign up for this class?

yes.0: I will notify Hughes the Fuse that you will be on your way! You should leave soon, since Orbis Tower is far from here!

no.0: Are you short on mesos? How foolish of you to curtail your desire for knowledge because of money!
